messages:
maria: deploy-bot detected surge in 5xxs for embed-service v2.3.0 in eu-west1. request: expedited rollout of v2.3.1 (hotfix) to stop user impact. tagging SRE and ops.

deploy-bot: alert: 2024-05-07T09:14:00Z - embed-service v2.3.0 error-rate 3.2% (eu-west1). suggested action: patch release v2.3.1 or rollback.

jonathan: oncall ack. beginning triage. any blocking infra or config changes in v2.3.1?

maria: no config/db changes. patch fixes retry race that caused spurious 5xxs. binary-only. image already built & scanned.

security: image scan complete (snyk/clair). no critical findings. ok from security.

carol: docs team needs a short changelog snippet and link before I sign off.

maria: notes: "Fix race in retry path that could surface intermittent 502/504 under bursty load. No schema or config changes." internal link: https://internal.releases/embed/2.3.1

ben-ops: expedited rule: need explicit rollback criteria + 3 approvals to bypass extended canary. propose rollback if: (a) sustained error-rate > 1% for 5m, (b) p95 latency increased > 400ms for 5m, or (c) spike in client timeouts > 1%.

sre-oncall: agree to criteria. i'll own monitoring and rollback. creating short alert rule now and will post runbook link.

sre-oncall: runbook: /runbooks/embed-hotfix-rollback.md. fallback options: revert to v2.3.0 in-region or shift traffic to eu-east. autoscaler pinned for window.

maria: preflight checks green. initiating deploy command: `/deploy release embed-service v2.3.1 --mode=express --ramp=10m`

deploy-bot: canary starting: 3 pods in eu-west1. metrics: https://metrics/embed/eu-west1/canary. approve_prompt: awaiting 3 approvals to skip extended canary.

maria: requesting quick thumbs. need 3 approvals.

carol: :thumbsup: docs + changelog attached.

product: :thumbsup: low risk, high user impact if not fixed.

ben-ops: :thumbsup: noted rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: approve_count=3/3. rolling: 0->100% over 10m starting 2024-05-07T09:20:00Z. ramp schedule emitted to channel.

sre-oncall: watching dashboards & logs. posting metric updates every 2m. alert thresholds active.

deploy-bot: ramp events: 25% @09:22, 50% @09:24, 75% @09:26, 100% @09:30.

sre-oncall: 09:24 snapshot: error-rate down to 0.25%, p95 stable, client timeouts normal. no rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks, continuing. will post release note after completion.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: v2.3.1 active at 100% in eu-west1 (2024-05-07T09:30:12Z).

sre-oncall: entering post-deploy watch for 10m window. will trigger rollback if criteria hit. so far 16m and healthy.

maria: release note published: https://internal.releases/embed/2.3.1/notes 9

jonathan: opened follow-up RL ticket RL-4520 to add unit + stress test for retry branch.

ben-ops: expedited window closed. file postmortem if any downstream issues crop up.

maria: closing thread 10
